title: Tomas's three days
disclaimer: Fictional simulation. Borovia, Kestria, Tomas, every company, statement and statistic here is invented.

notification.author: Synergexa
notification.text: Our servers are fine. Unrelatedly, our servers are down. We apologise for any inconvenience.

shots.narration: This is Tomas. He writes reassuring pamphlets for Kestria. At ten, the internet went down.

notification.author: Desk Anchor Morgan Vale
notification.text: Our analyst says this is either an escalation or a de-escalation. More after the break.

shots.narration: By noon, Borovia had mobilised. Tomas was asked to make the pamphlets more reassuring.

notification.author: ThriftJet Air
notification.text: ThriftJet now offers Evacuation Class: same seat, louder announcements. Bags extra.

shots.narration: At one, the sirens. Tomas went underground, with the pamphlets.
At ten past two, a nuclear weapon was detonated over the Kestrel Point naval base.

notification.author: Committee for Global Stability (Interim)
notification.text: Emergency session convened. First item on the agenda: whether this is on the agenda.

shots.narration: Underground, an emergency meeting was scheduled to schedule the emergency meeting.

notification.author: Committee for Global Stability (Interim)
notification.text: The committee congratulates itself on the ceasefire, which it read about this morning.

shots.narration: On day two, a ceasefire. Both sides argued about the table.

notification.author: Brandwell Inc.
notification.text: We apologise for any inconvenience the crisis caused. The crisis was not us. Use code BACK20.

shots.narration: On day three, Tomas came home. The pamphlets were finally ready.
